name: Cross Cut
description: A diagonal stroke drawn from shoulder to hip, the first cut every novice of the Order learns in the Birgu yards. Is accurate.

name: Pilgrim's Thrust
description: A straight lunge aimed at the seams between plates, taught to knights who walked to Jerusalem and back. Pierces about half of the target's DEF.

name: Shieldbreaker
description: Both arms of the armatura drive one crushing blow down onto the foe's guard. Saps the target, so its blows land lighter on its next turn.

name: Eight-Point Flurry
description: Two cuts traced like the arms of the eight-pointed cross, one rising and one falling. Strikes twice for lighter damage each and pierces about half of the target's DEF.

name: Stoccata Lunga
description: A long, precise lunge in the Italian manner, learned in the fencing hall of the Auberge of Italy. Hits a little harder than a plain strike and is very accurate.

name: Last Rampart
description: A great two-handed overhead blow delivered as if holding the last breach at St Elmo. Hits very hard. Only medium or heavy frames carry its weight.

name: Shield Bash
description: The shield boss is rammed forward into the enemy's chest plate before they can set their feet. Knocks the target down unless it defends: no strike back, and it starts its next turn short of AP.

name: Rim Strike
description: The shield rim snaps up under the chin of the enemy's helm. Is accurate.

name: Bell-Ringer
description: A swinging mace blow to the helm that sets the whole harness ringing like the bells of San Lorenzo. Tires the target.

name: Helm Splitter
description: A flanged mace brought down on the crest of a helmet with a woodsman's swing. Hits a little harder than a plain strike and pierces about half of the target's DEF.

name: Knell of Saint John
description: One toll of the great bell of the Conventual Church, made flesh in iron. Tires the target.

name: Hedge of Pikes
description: The pike is levelled and held firm, a single point standing for a whole Spanish square. Knocks the target down unless it defends: no strike back, and it starts its next turn short of AP.

name: Lance of Aragon
description: A short galloping rush with the polearm couched under the arm, in the manner of Aragonese jousters. Hits hard and reaches two tiles.

name: Halberd Hook
description: The hook behind the halberd blade catches a belt or a stirrup and drags the target off balance. Slows the target by 1 MOV on its next turn and reaches two tiles.

name: Knight's Charge
description: The full weight of a medium armatura behind a lowered polearm, boilers roaring. Hits hard, crashes through any guard: no strike back, and the target loses much of its next turn and reaches two tiles. Only medium frames carry its weight.

name: Charge of the Langues
description: Knights of every Langue lower their lances together and ride as one body. Hits very hard and reaches two tiles. Only medium frames carry its weight.

name: Fisherman's Hook-Cut
description: A sharp curling cut learned gutting fish on the Marsaxlokk quays. Is accurate.

name: Żejtun Feint
description: A false step to one side, then two short cuts from the other, a trick of the Żejtun lanes. Strikes twice for lighter damage each and pierces about half of the target's DEF.

name: Harvest Swing
description: A wide sweeping cut swung like a sickle through the summer wheat. Tires the target.

name: Carob Split
description: A full overhead chop with the strength used to split carob logs. Hits very hard.

name: Last Stand
description: No retreat is left, so no part of the body is spared in the swing. Hits a little harder than a plain strike, tires the target and knocks the target down unless it defends: no strike back, and it starts its next turn short of AP.

name: Pitchfork Jab
description: A quick two-handed jab with the polearm from behind a field wall. Is accurate and reaches two tiles.

name: Brace and Drive
description: The butt is planted against the limestone and the point driven home as the foe comes on. Knocks the target down unless it defends: no strike back, and it starts its next turn short of AP and reaches two tiles.

name: Watchtower Sweep
description: A broad low sweep of the polearm, as the coastal watch fends off landing parties. Slows the target by 1 MOV on its next turn and reaches two tiles.

name: Gaff Hook
description: A fisherman's gaff dragged across the enemy's footing. Tires the target and reaches two tiles.

name: Wallbreaker
description: A long spear driven into the head of a scaling ladder and heaved back. Hits very hard and reaches two tiles.

name: Aimed Shot
description: A slow, careful shot, matchlock braced and breath held until the moment is right. Is accurate and pierces part of the target's DEF.

name: Double Charge
description: The arquebus is loaded with a double measure of powder and ball, risking the barrel. Hits hard.

name: Crossfire
description: Two quick shots from alternating firing positions behind the bastion parapet. Strikes twice for lighter damage each and pierces about half of the target's DEF.

name: Braced Shot
description: The arquebus is laid on the parapet wall and the shot taken on the breath. Hits a little harder than a plain strike and pierces about half of the target's DEF.

name: Sharpshooter
description: A patient shot aimed at the vision slit or a boiler joint. Hits hard, is accurate and pierces about half of the target's DEF.

name: Crescent Slash
description: A curving draw-cut that follows the line of the kilij's blade. Is accurate.

name: Drawing Cut
description: The yatagan's curve slides through the target's guard in a single pulling stroke. Pierces about half of the target's DEF.

name: Janissary's Oath
description: A heavy overhead cut delivered with the full discipline of the Sultan's household infantry. Hits hard.

name: Twin Moons
description: Two crescent cuts in quick succession, one high and one low. Strikes twice for lighter damage each and pierces about half of the target's DEF.

name: Sultan's Edge
description: A perfect drawing slash reserved for veterans in medium frames, aimed at joints and seams. Hits a little harder than a plain strike and pierces about half of the target's DEF. Only medium frames carry its weight.

name: Steady Volley
description: A measured tüfek shot fired from a braced stance, as drilled in the ortas. Is accurate.

name: Rolling Fire
description: Two shots in quick succession, a second barrel or a fast reload. Strikes twice for lighter damage each and pierces about half of the target's DEF.

name: Tufek Salvo
description: Two ranks fire as one and the powder-smoke closes in around the target. Tires the target.

name: Marksman of the Orta
description: A long-barrelled tüfek shot laid carefully on a weak point. Hits a little harder than a plain strike and pierces about half of the target's DEF.

name: Fire Line of the Orta
description: The whole orta fires in order, rank behind rank. Strikes twice for lighter damage each and pierces about half of the target's DEF.

name: Lance Feint
description: The lance tip dips as if to strike low, then darts high. Is accurate and reaches two tiles.

name: Sipahi Charge
description: A light armatura sweeps in at speed with lance lowered, in the manner of the provincial cavalry. Hits hard and reaches two tiles. Only light frames carry its weight.

name: Hooked Spear Pull
description: A hooked lance-head catches the strap of a shield and tears it away. Knocks the target down unless it defends: no strike back, and it starts its next turn short of AP and reaches two tiles.

name: Akinji Sweep
description: The raiders of the frontier sweep their lances low across a line of men. Slows the target by 2 MOV on its next turn and reaches two tiles.

name: Thunder of Hooves
description: Light frames gallop in at full speed and drive the lance through. Hits hard, crashes through any guard: no strike back, and the target loses much of its next turn and reaches two tiles. Only light frames carry its weight.

name: Fire Pot
description: A clay pot of burning naphtha is hurled to burst against the target's plates. Hits hard.

name: Smoke and Iron
description: A bomb packed with iron scraps and thick smoke is lobbed at the foe. Tires the target.

name: Humbara Cluster
description: Two clay grenades from one hand, the second hard on the first. Strikes twice for lighter damage each and pierces about half of the target's DEF.

name: Burning Pitch
description: A cask of blazing pitch is flung to coat the armatura in fire. Tires the target.

name: Tophane Barrage
description: The gunners of the Tophane arsenal lob a hail of fire-pots. Strikes twice for lighter damage each and pierces about half of the target's DEF.

name: Boarding Slash
description: A quick cut delivered while leaping across a galley's rail. Is accurate.

name: Deck Dance
description: Two light cuts made while dancing across a pitching deck. Strikes twice for lighter damage each and pierces about half of the target's DEF.

name: Salt and Steel
description: A wide sweeping cut flung with the swing of a ship's boom. Tires the target.

name: Cutlass Storm
description: A flurry of cutlass work in the confusion of a boarding. Strikes twice for lighter damage each, pierces about half of the target's DEF and tires the target.

name: Barbary Reaper
description: A whirling full-body sweep of the blade, the signature of the Barbary raiders. Hits very hard.

name: Boat-Hook Jab
description: A short jab with the boat-hook, the same motion used to fend a boat off a quay. Is accurate.

name: Grapple
description: An iron hook is thrown into the target's plates and hauled tight. Knocks the target down unless it defends: no strike back, and it starts its next turn short of AP.

name: Keelhaul
description: The armatura is hooked and wrenched off balance, then driven into the ground. Slows the target by 1 MOV on its next turn.

name: Harpoon Thrust
description: A whaler's thrust that bites deep behind the plates. Hits a little harder than a plain strike, pierces about half of the target's DEF and reaches two tiles.

name: Drowning Hook
description: The hook sets in the armour and the target is dragged down like a catch hauled overboard. Hits a little harder than a plain strike, tires the target and knocks the target down unless it defends: no strike back, and it starts its next turn short of AP.

name: Piston Strike
description: A steam piston fires the fist forward with a hiss and a crack. Is accurate.

name: Valve Release
description: A hiss of steam into the joints just before the blow lands. Tires the target.

name: Steam Hammer
description: Valves open fully and the arm falls like a forge hammer. Hits hard.

name: Governor Slam
description: A governor wheel spun up to speed and released into the blow. Hits a little harder than a plain strike and pierces about half of the target's DEF.

name: Overpressure
description: The boiler is pushed beyond its safe limit for one shattering blow. Hits very hard.

name: Rivet Shot
description: A rivet gun pressed into service as a weapon: accurate, and it pierces a little of the target's DEF. Is accurate and pierces part of the target's DEF.

name: Grapeshot
description: A charge of grapeshot is fired from a hull-mounted gun. Strikes twice for lighter damage each and pierces about half of the target's DEF.

name: Siege Bolt
description: A heavy iron bolt is driven from a steam launcher. Hits hard.

name: Chain Shot
description: Two linked balls on a chain that tear through rigging and plate. Slows the target by 1 MOV on its next turn.

name: Full Broadside
description: Every gun on a heavy machine fires at once in a single roar. Hits hard and crashes through any guard: no strike back, and the target loses much of its next turn. Only heavy frames carry its weight.

name: Bastion Riposte
description: A parry on the bastion wall that becomes a thrust before the foe has finished his stroke. Hits a little harder than a plain strike and pierces about half of the target's DEF.

name: Sword of Saint Michael
description: The archangel's blade as the Order's smiths imagine it, brought down in a single stroke of terrible weight. Hits devastatingly hard.

name: Dawn of the Grand Master
description: The two cuts La Valette taught every knight on the walls: one to open the guard, one to end the fight. Strikes twice for lighter damage each, is accurate, pierces about half of the target's DEF and tires the target.

name: Cathedral Bell
description: A mace stroke that rings through the whole frame like the great bell of the Conventual Church. Hits a little harder than a plain strike, tires the target and knocks the target down unless it defends: no strike back, and it starts its next turn short of AP.

name: Gate-Breaker
description: A flanged blow aimed at the weakest hinge, as fit for a postern door as for a pilot's plating. Hits hard and ignores most of the target's DEF.

name: Judgement of the Langues
description: Every Langue of the Order in one swing: a blow that cannot be answered and leaves the foe reeling. Hits very hard, tires the target and crashes through any guard: no strike back, and the target loses much of its next turn.

name: Pike Wall of Aragon
description: A hedge of Aragonese pike points that holds a whole street against a charge. Hits a little harder than a plain strike, tires the target, knocks the target down unless it defends: no strike back, and it starts its next turn short of AP and reaches two tiles.

name: Lancer's Reckoning
description: The charge of a heavy knight at full tilt, aimed at the gap between helm and gorget. Hits hard and ignores most of the target's DEF. Only medium frames carry its weight.

name: Valette's Sortie
description: The sortie that saved Birgu: a charge that bursts out of the gate when the enemy thinks the walls are his. Hits very hard, tires the target and crashes through any guard: no strike back, and the target loses much of its next turn. Only medium frames carry its weight.

name: Carob Sickle
description: A farmer's sickle stroke taken to the knees, learned bringing in the carobs of the Żejtun hills. Slows the target by 2 MOV on its next turn.

name: Strike of the Old Stones
description: The weight of the temple builders in a single chop: heavy, plain and hard to turn. Hits devastatingly hard.

name: Defender of the Island
description: Three generations of sieges in one blow: everything Malta's soldiers have learned about not giving way. Hits very hard, tires the target and crashes through any guard: no strike back, and the target loses much of its next turn.

name: Ladder-Pusher
description: A long pole set against the top of a scaling ladder and heaved: the oldest defence in the world. Hits a little harder than a plain strike, tires the target, knocks the target down unless it defends: no strike back, and it starts its next turn short of AP and reaches two tiles.

name: Watchfire Thrust
description: A thrust delivered as the beacon on the tower is lit, with the whole village behind it. Hits hard, ignores most of the target's DEF and reaches two tiles.

name: Gate of Birgu
description: A spear wall that shuts the street like the great gate of Birgu: reaching, relentless, nearly uncounterable. Hits very hard, tires the target, crashes through any guard: no strike back, and the target loses much of its next turn and reaches two tiles.

name: Parapet Shot
description: The arquebus laid in a crenel and the shot taken on a held breath: steady, accurate and hard to counter. Hits a little harder than a plain strike and is very accurate.

name: Bastion Volley
description: Two shots from a loaded pair, fired from the same loophole before the smoke clears. Strikes twice for lighter damage each, is accurate and pierces about half of the target's DEF.

name: Dead Aim of Malta
description: The shot every Maltese gunner means to make once in his life: unhurried, exact and through the gap in the plate. Hits hard, is very accurate and ignores most of the target's DEF.

name: Sabre of the Divan
description: A pulling stroke taught in the Sultan's own school, so smooth it seems to take no effort. Hits a little harder than a plain strike and is very accurate.

name: Whirlwind of the Corps
description: The janissary spin: two sweeping cuts before the enemy has found his feet. Strikes twice for lighter damage each, is accurate, pierces part of the target's DEF and knocks the target down unless it defends: no strike back, and it starts its next turn short of AP.

name: Blade of the Padishah
description: The stroke reserved for the Sultan's guard: three cuts in the time of one. Strikes three times for lighter damage each, is accurate and pierces about half of the target's DEF.

name: Orta Platoon Fire
description: A platoon's volley in rolling ranks, each man firing as the one before reloads. Saps the target, so its blows land lighter on its next turn and slows the target by 1 MOV on its next turn.

name: Veteran of Rhodes
description: A shot made by a man who has taken a fortress before, and means to again. Hits hard, is very accurate and ignores most of the target's DEF.

name: Thunder of the Corps
description: The whole corps fires at once: three shots, and the din alone is enough to unnerve the target. Strikes three times for lighter damage each, is accurate and pierces about half of the target's DEF.

name: Akinji Lance
description: A raider's lance couched low and driven home at a gallop across rough ground. Hits very hard.

name: Hooked Lance Haul
description: A barbed lance-head that drags a pilot off his feet and leaves him sprawling. Hits hard, pierces part of the target's DEF, tires the target, knocks the target down unless it defends: no strike back, and it starts its next turn short of AP and reaches two tiles.

name: Wrath of the Sipahi
description: The charge of the Sultan's household cavalry, which has never been stopped on an open field. Hits very hard, tires the target and crashes through any guard: no strike back, and the target loses much of its next turn.

name: Naphtha Flask
description: A clay flask of burning naphtha that coats the target's armour and the pilot inside it. Saps the target, so its blows land lighter on its next turn and slows the target by 1 MOV on its next turn.

name: Hail of Greek Fire
description: A fistful of fire-pots thrown on a flat arc: two blasts that find the seams of the armour. Strikes twice for lighter damage each, is accurate, pierces about half of the target's DEF and tires the target.

name: Fire of the Tophane
description: The arsenal's finest work, loosed all at once: three blasts that bite through plate and wear the pilot out. Strikes three times for lighter damage each, is accurate and pierces about half of the target's DEF.

name: Boarding Frenzy
description: The first minutes on an enemy deck, when every cut lands at once. Strikes twice for lighter damage each, is accurate and pierces about half of the target's DEF.

name: Sea-Wolf's Rush
description: A pounce from the rail that carries the whole body into the blade. Hits very hard, tires the target and crashes through any guard: no strike back, and the target loses much of its next turn.

name: Scourge of the Barbary Coast
description: The name the coast gives to the captain who leaves no deck standing: three cuts and a kick for the stragglers. Strikes three times for lighter damage each, is accurate and pierces about half of the target's DEF.

name: Gaff and Chain
description: A gaff with a chain on the shaft that wraps the target's limbs and wears him down. Slows the target by 2 MOV on its next turn.

name: Harpooner's Heave
description: A whaler's heave that drives the harpoon in to the shaft. Hits hard, ignores most of the target's DEF and reaches two tiles.

name: Leviathan Hook
description: A hook that has landed a hundred wrecks and dragged every one of them down. Hits very hard, tires the target and crashes through any guard: no strike back, and the target loses much of its next turn.

name: Piston Cascade
description: Three pistons fired in a row, each a little harder than the last. Strikes three times for lighter damage each and pierces about half of the target's DEF.

name: Boiler Burst
description: A held boiler released through the arm all at once: a blow that no armour was designed for. Hits very hard, tires the target and crashes through any guard: no strike back, and the target loses much of its next turn.

name: The Engineer's Masterpiece
description: The one machine Scala never sold: a blow built over a year, delivered in a moment. Hits devastatingly hard and tires the target.

name: Pressure Round
description: A round fired on a spring of steam: accurate beyond the range of the eye. Hits hard, is accurate and pierces about half of the target's DEF.

name: Hail of Rivets
description: A rack of rivet guns discharged together: two bursts that find every gap. Strikes twice for lighter damage each, is accurate, pierces about half of the target's DEF and saps the target, so its blows land lighter on its next turn.

name: Thunder Engine
description: A whole engine worked into a gun: three shots in a breath, each tearing the plate a little more. Strikes three times for lighter damage each, is accurate and pierces about half of the target's DEF.
